## Activity

During March 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 432 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting month. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the number of results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 432 captures, 83 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 19.2. This indicates that a notable proportion of submitted images could not proceed through assessment. The result should be monitored through routine site review, with attention given to any recurring issues affecting image capture and the completeness of the submitted sets.

## Grading

Grading identified 83 referable results during March 2024. The median lag between capture and grading was 3. This provides an indication of the time taken for results to progress through the grading process. Activity, image quality and grading measures should continue to be reviewed together to support oversight of the service at Market Eye Clinic.
